name: gemm
summary: C = A @ B (2D GEMM) with optional transA/transB via AttrBlob. Variants: (1) f32 naive strided kernel, (2) f16 WMMA tensor-core path with f16 output (requires C contiguous row-major).
contract: - strides must be valid (>0) for both dims (strided allowed)
- f16 TC path: A,B,C all f16 (wmma accumulator is f32 internally, stored to f16)
- Controls logical 2D views without physically transposing tensors
Extra constraint for f16 TC variant:
- C must be contiguous row-major (stride[1]==1 and stride[0]==shape[1])
abi: - If schema_id is neither 0 nor 'GEMM' => treat as defaults (transA=0, transB=0)
notes: MatView2D is formed from TensorDesc shape/stride; transpose swaps logical rows/cols and uses swapped strides.
gemm_check_2d enforces: rank==2, dtype match, positive strides, consistent shapes after transpose, and positive M,N,K.
No alpha/beta scaling: this op computes pure matmul only (no C = alpha*A@B + beta*C).
f16 TC variant uses WMMA fragments (16x16x16) with A row-major, B col-major packing into shared memory.
WMMA path pads K to ceil16(K) with zero-fill loads (out-of-bounds loads return 0).

variants.name: gemm_f32_naive_strided
supported: A,B,C: strides valid (>0 for both dims)
Attr: schema_id in {0,'GEMM'} or anything else (treated as default)
After applying transA/transB: A_view=[M,K], B_view=[K,N], C=[M,N]
notes: Each thread computes one C element with a K loop (no tiling).

variants.name: gemm_f16_tc_wmma_out_f16_strided
supported: A,B,C: strides valid (>0 for both dims)
After applying transA/transB: A_view=[M,K], B_view=[K,N], C=[M,N]
TC requirement: C is contiguous row-major (stride[1]==1 && stride[0]==C.shape[1])
notes: Per-tile: pack A as row-major 16x16 into smem, pack B as col-major 16x16 into smem, wmma::mma_sync accumulates in f32.
Store: accumulator -> smemC (row-major f32), then convert/store to f16 C with bounds checks.
K is padded to ceil16(K); out-of-range loads are treated as 0.

experiments.title: Tile f32 GEMM (shared memory) to replace naive K loop
experiments.change: Replace per-element naive kernel with block tiling (e.g., 128x64xK tile), shared memory staging for A/B, and register blocking.
experiments.why: Current f32 path is O(M*N*K) with no data reuse; extremely slow for anything beyond tiny matrices.
experiments.hypothesis: Tiling increases arithmetic intensity and reduces global loads; large speedup vs naive kernel.
experiments.proof: ncu: global load efficiency, achieved FLOP/s; compare vs cublas reference timing.
experiments.next: Add vectorized loads, double-buffering, and optionally mma for f16/f32 mixed modes.

experiments.title: Relax TC constraint by adding store path for strided C
experiments.change: Allow non-contiguous C by storing each element with (Crs,Ccs) instead of assuming row-major contiguous; keep wmma compute the same.
experiments.why: Current TC gating blocks many legitimate strided outputs; only store path needs to be strided-aware.
experiments.hypothesis: Broader applicability with minimal perf loss when C is mildly strided; still faster than f16 naive.
experiments.proof: Correctness tests with transposed/strided C; benchmark store overhead.
experiments.next: If store overhead is high, add epilogue kernel to reorder into contiguous buffer.

experiments.title: Shared memory layout tweaks to reduce bank conflicts in WMMA pack
experiments.change: Adjust smemA/smemB layout (padding or swizzle) to reduce bank conflicts when packing 16x16 tiles.
experiments.why: Current smem arrays are tight 256 elements; bank conflicts can hurt warp load/store efficiency.
experiments.hypothesis: Improves WMMA kernel throughput for large M,N.
experiments.proof: ncu shared_load_transactions_per_request / bank conflict metrics; compare runtime.
experiments.next: Try padding leading dimension to 16+1 or use ldmatrix-friendly layout on newer arch.

measurements.notes: Report latency and achieved TFLOP/s (2*M*N*K ops). Compare against cublasGemmEx if available.
